def transform(ctx):
    sheet = "호유형별_통화요금_합산"
    last_row = ctx.last_row(sheet, col=2)
    if last_row < 2:
        raise ValueError("B열에 데이터가 없습니다.")
    
    vals = ctx.read(sheet, f"B2:B{last_row}")
    out = [[v * 0.7 if isinstance(v, (int, float)) else 0 for v in row] for row in vals]
    
    ctx.write(sheet, "C2", out)

Sub B2BSkill()
    Dim prevCalc As XlCalculation
    Dim raisedNum As Long, raisedSrc As String, raisedDesc As String
    On Error GoTo Cleanup
    prevCalc = Application.Calculation
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual

    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = ActiveWorkbook.ActiveSheet

    Dim usedRng As Range
    Set usedRng = ws.UsedRange

    Dim cell As Range
    For Each cell In usedRng.Cells
        If IsNumeric(cell.Value) And Not IsEmpty(cell.Value) Then
            cell.NumberFormatLocal = "_(* #,##0.00_);_(* (#,##0.00);_(* \"-\"??_);_(@_)"
        End If
    Next cell

        raisedNum = Err.Number
        raisedSrc = Err.Source
        raisedDesc = Err.Description
    End If
    Application.Calculation = prevCalc
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    If raisedNum <> 0 Then Err.Raise raisedNum, raisedSrc, raisedDesc
End Sub

```vba
Sub B2BSkill()
```

```vba
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, wsOut As Worksheet
    Dim lastRow As Long
    Dim dict As Object
    Dim arr As Variant
    Dim outArr() As Variant
    Dim i As Long, rowIdx As Long
    Dim dataRng As Range
    Dim hVal As Variant, rVal As Variant
    Dim amount As Double
    Dim key As String
    Dim tempStr As String
    Dim keys As Variant
    Dim sh As Worksheet
    Dim wbIter As Workbook
    
    On Error GoTo Cleanup
    prevCalc = Application.Calculation
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual
    
    ' 파일 찾기
    Set wb = Nothing
    For Each wbIter In Application.Workbooks
        If wbIter.Name = "571601213953_한화테크윈_판교_26년06월_DSMC_260604.xlsx" Then
            Set wb = wbIter
            Exit For
        End If
    Next wbIter
    If wb Is Nothing Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 513, "B2BSkill", "'571601213953_한화테크윈_판교_26년06월_DSMC_260604.xlsx' 파일을 찾을 수 없습니다."
    
    ' 시트 찾기
    Set ws = Nothing
    For Each sh In wb.Worksheets
        If sh.Name = "VIEW" Then
            Set ws = sh
            Exit For
        End If
    Next sh
    If ws Is Nothing Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 513, "B2BSkill", "'VIEW' 시트를 찾을 수 없습니다."
    
    ' 데이터 범위 확인 (H열: 8)
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, 8).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < 2 Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 513, "B2BSkill", "데이터가 없습니다."
    
    ' 배열로 읽기 (H열:8 ~ R열:18)
    Set dataRng = ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, 8), ws.Cells(lastRow, 18))
    arr = dataRng.Value
    
    ' Dictionary 초기화
    Set dict = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    
    ' 합산 루프
    For rowIdx = 1 To UBound(arr, 1)
        hVal = arr(rowIdx, 1)
        rVal = arr(rowIdx, 11) ' 18 - 8 + 1 = 11
        
        key = Trim(CStr(hVal))
        If key = "" Or key = "Empty" Then key = "미분류"
        
        amount = 0
        If IsNumeric(rVal) Then
            amount = CDbl(rVal)
        ElseIf Not IsEmpty(rVal) Then
            tempStr = Replace(CStr(rVal), ",", "")
            If IsNumeric(tempStr) Then
                amount = CDbl(tempStr)
            End If
        End If
        
        If dict.Exists(key) Then
            dict(key) = dict(key) + amount
        Else
            dict.Add key, amount
        End If
    Next rowIdx
    
    ' 결과 시트 생성 (중복 확인 및 삭제)
    Set wsOut = Nothing
    For Each sh In wb.Worksheets
        If sh.Name = "호유형별_통화요금_합산" Then
            Application.DisplayAlerts = False
            sh.Delete
            Application.DisplayAlerts = True
            Exit For
        End If
    Next sh
    
    Set wsOut = wb.Worksheets.Add(After:=wb.Worksheets(wb.Worksheets.Count))
    wsOut.Name = "호유형별_통화요금_합산"
    
    ' 결과 쓰기
    If dict.Count > 0 Then
        ReDim outArr(1 To dict.Count, 1 To 2)
        keys = dict.Keys
        For i = 0 To dict.Count - 1
            outArr(i + 1, 1) = keys(i)
            outArr(i + 1, 2) = dict(keys(i))
        Next i
        
        wsOut.Range("A1").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("호유형", "통화요금_합계")
        wsOut.Range("A2").Resize(dict.Count, 2).Value = outArr
        
        wsOut.Columns("A:B").AutoFit
        wsOut.Range("B2").Resize(dict.Count, 1).NumberFormat = "#,##0"
    Else
        wsOut.Range("A1").Value = "호유형"
        wsOut.Range("B1").Value = "통화요금_합계"
    End If

Cleanup:
    Application.Calculation = prevCalc
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        Err.Raise Err.Number, Err.Source, Err.Description
    End If
End Sub
```

```python
def transform(ctx):
    sheet = "호유형별_통화요금_합산"
    last_row = ctx.last_row(sheet, col=2)
    if last_row < 2:
        raise ValueError("B열에 데이터가 없습니다.")
    
    vals = ctx.read(sheet, f"B2:B{last_row}")
    out = [[v * 0.7 if isinstance(v, (int, float)) else 0 for v in row] for row in vals]
    
    ctx.write(sheet, "C2", out)
```

```python
def transform(ctx):
    sheet = ctx.sheets()[0]
    last_r = ctx.last_row(sheet)
    last_c = ctx.last_col(sheet)
    
    def col_to_letter(c):
        s = ""
        while c > 0:
            c, r = divmod(c - 1, 26)
            s = chr(r + 65) + s
        return s
        
    rng = f"A1:{col_to_letter(last_c)}{last_r}"
    fmt = '_(* #,##0.00_);_(* (#,##0.00);_(* "-"??_);_(@_)'
    ctx.set_number_format(sheet, rng, fmt)
```
